EmpiricalPossibilitySliceProviderReceipt.identity_is_well_founded: receipt identity hashes a preimage that excludes the receipt's own ref/hash (no self-referential digest)
binds: producer fact identity and typed state
consumer result state and identity hash (or null)

invariants: An EXACT result must carry generated evidence and a consumer result that are the very objects produced by the accepted composition (identity check, not equality).
A REFUSED result must carry no evidence, no consumer result and no geometry.
A receipt/result provider-state mismatch is rejected at construction.
A receipt/result composed-identity mismatch is rejected at construction.
The provider must not accept precomputed probability geometry as authoritative input.
The provider must not duplicate empirical calculation by manually constructing probabilities.

typed_refusals: producer fact typed_state not SUPPORTED -> typed refusal, no geometry
model source-universe out of scope -> consumer returns FAIL_CLOSED / MODEL_SOURCE_UNIVERSE_OUT_OF_SCOPE as an exact-lane result

non_authority_ceiling.note: An N10E provider receipt is a branch-local proof artifact, not adoption and not an AT33 progressive-world claim.
